    requires interval2.0 <= interval1.1 // start of interval2 is less than or equal to end of interval1
    ensures result == "YES" || result == "NO" // result is either "YES" or "NO"

    ensures (result == "NO" ==> (interval1.1 < interval2.0 || interval2.1 < interval1.0 || !isPrime(intersectionLength(interval1, interval2)))) // if result is "NO", either no intersection or intersection length is not prime

// Helper function to calculate the length of the intersection
method intersectionLength(interval1: (int, int), interval2: (int, int)) returns (length: int)
    ensures length >= 0 // length of intersection is non-negative
    ensures (length > 0 ==> (interval1.1 >= interval2.0 && interval2.1 >= interval1.0)) // positive length implies intervals intersect
    ensures (length == 0 ==> (interval1.1 < interval2.0 || interval2.1 < interval1.0)) // zero length implies no intersection

method isPrime(n: int) returns (result: bool)
    requires n >= 0 // n must be non-negative
    ensures result == (n > 1 && forall d: int :: (2 <= d && d * d <= n ==> (n % d != 0))) // result is true if n is prime
